# Standalone flat-line references

These are original OPC/DrawingML controls, generated by
`tools/flat_line_fixture.py` using the existing numeric-page-fields package as
a shell. No private corpus content or font binary is included. The
reference application opened the source read-only and exported `native.pdf` without saving.

The eight pages contain horizontal, vertical, rotated horizontal, rotated
vertical, scaled horizontal, scaled vertical, inline horizontal and inline
vertical lines, respectively. Each has a 2pt red flat-cap stroke. The first
six are page-anchored at (144pt, 144pt); the last two follow Arial 12pt text.
Every line has exactly one zero extent in both its DrawingML transform and
WordprocessingML drawing frame. Scaled cases double the nonzero frame extent
relative to the internal shape extent.

`tools/record_flat_lines.py` renders the native reference PDF at four pixels per point and
measures the saturated red stroke bounds independently of engine geometry.
The JSON hashes the source and PDF and records the 0.25pt measurement grid.
The first horizontal line paints (144,143)–(252,145)pt and the first vertical
line (143,144)–(145,252)pt. The scaled cases retain the same 2pt physical pen.
Rotation paints beyond the zero-area drawing frame. Inline cases retain the
line's zero frame dimension while participating in line layout.

The official ECMA transitional `ST_PositiveCoordinate` definition permits
zero (`minInclusive=0`), despite its name. All five source XML validation
checks pass, including the supported DrawingML extension view. The reference application's ability
to render these lines does not establish a specification divergence.

The baseline strict import rejected the first line with `empty shape extents`;
best-effort import dropped all eight drawings. The implementation retains zero
frames and derives raster scale from the nonzero axis. Stroke selection follows
directed endpoints with a small pointer tolerance rather than a zero-area box.
The browser regression compares the native reference ink bounds within 1pt (including raster
rounding), clicks horizontal/vertical/rotated/inline strokes, and checks edits,
package retention, exact undo and reopening. Unit checks retain drawing XML
exactly and reject malformed frames and ordinary zero-sized pictures.

Zero-area groups/pictures, point-sized lines, text on standalone flat shapes,
mismatched inner/outer collapsed axes remain guarded. Percentage-sized flat
frames are covered separately by `../relative-flat-lines/`. These original
controls do not establish all wrapping modes.
